text:
emma: quick lane — pushing hotfix to address embedding 503 spike seen in eu-west1. patch image: redwood/inference:hotfix-embed-2025-03-14. dry-run ✅ in staging. requesting expedited approve for midnight change window (canary 10% -> 100% if green). tl;dr: low-risk config tweak + retry backoff.
deploybot: scheduled deploy 1748579400 for redwood/inference:hotfix-embed-2025-03-14 -> starting canary (eu-west1, 10%)
jordan_sre: quick checks done — CPU/mem in staging look fine. can we add a short smoke test in prod canary to validate embeddings endpoint responds < 200ms for 1k samples? i can run it once deployed.
emma: yes — plan is smoke -> traffic ramp if no 503s for 15m. smoke test script: `curl -sS -X POST /v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'`
ops-lead: pinging oncall for expedited signoff. @jordan_sre and @anne please ack if you saw staging results.
anne: saw staging, logs look clean. :thumbsup: I want a quick post-deploy rollback criteria: >0.5% 5xx or CPU >85% sustained for 2m.
paul: agree on rollback criteria. if canary fails we rollback to `redwood/inference:2025-03-10-release-candidate` and open follow-up ticket.
sara: FYI release notes link: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/2025-03-14-hotfix-embed
release_manager: expedited approval vote — react with :thumbsup: to proceed. we need 3 ops/sre votes.
emma: starting canary now. deploybot logs: `canary: created; pods=4; image=hotfix-embed-2025-03-14; target=10%`
deploybot: health checks passing (3/4 pods ready). routing 10% traffic.
jordan_sre: running smoke now -> 1000 samples. results: 0 503s, p95=180ms. looks good so far.
anne: monitoring metrics, no spike in error rate. :white_check_mark:
paul: +1
sara: +1, merging release note snippet into the changelog.
release_manager: 4 approvals received. ops-lead you have final call to ramp.
ops-lead: ramp to 50% for 10m, then to 100% if stable. execute.
emma: running ramp. deploybot: scaling canary -> 50% traffic.
deploybot: canary 50% live. health checks stable.
jordan_sre: monitoring — errors still 0, latency steady. proceeding to full rollout in 8m unless objections.
anne: no objections. go for 100% at +8m.
deploybot: rolling to 100% now. finalizing.
deploybot: SUCCESS — rollout complete, all traffic on redwood/inference:hotfix-embed-2025-03-14. post-deploy smoke: 0 5xx, p95=185ms.
paul: excellent. closing ticket and tagging follow-up items for additional tests on edge nodes.
release_manager: release note published and ops checklist completed. thanks team — expedited path worked as expected. :tada:
